# No manual wrapping: patchline.py supplies pixel-aware line breaks.

column2: After taking that many attacks, you are not hurt anywhere?
Every battle so far was an illusion I created!
Sir $$ヨハネ$$, you have already realized, have you not?
How peculiar those who wear the $$大邪神$$'s armor are.
In this $$世界$$, where $$弱肉強食$$ is the norm,
their judgment is utterly paralyzed—they let themselves be killed merely because the $$弱者$$ ask them to.
is the very proof that they are $$救世主$$s, apostles of this $$世界$$'s $$大悪神$$, $$ゴッド$$!!
I pledge myself and all my knowledge to you.
To $$ノア$$, the Land of Enslavement!!
I understand what you are trying to say...
But if we take what that old man says at face value...
we will trust that old man right here...
and readily follow him—yet that irrational decision...
will be proof that he is the $$救世主$$... will it not!?
